Senior Capstone Project — 09/2025 to 05/2026

Designed and built a handheld ultrasonic transducer array to acoustically levitate and manipulate 5mm polystyrene spheres.

Approximated acoustic field behavior using standing wave theory to guide transducer placement and phasing, then wrote Python software to control the transducer array and drive real-time levitation and movement of the spheres.
items.summary: A handheld ultrasonic transducer array that acoustically levitates and manipulates small objects in mid-air.
items.title: Handheld Acoustic Levitation Device

items.body:
LVPDU Switch — 06/2024 to 09/2024

Designed, prototyped, and tested a switch to assist in protecting a battery system. The switch was sensitive to voltage, current, and temperature. And was designed to fail open in all cases to protect the battery.
items.summary: Essentially a glorified switch to protect a medium voltage battery
items.title: LVPDU Open-Fail Switch
